package.name: luchs_sdk
package.description: ROS-independent C++17 SDK for Luchs A and Luchs B robot chassis: CAN protocol codecs (Luchs A v1.1, LCI v1.0, Luchs B VCU V2.6), SocketCAN transport, steering kinematics, a thread-safe chassis client with command watchdog and heartbeat, simulators, and the luchs_cli tool. The same sources are built by luchs_ros1 (ROS 1) as a plain CMake package.
package.author: TerraAgent Robotics
